remarks: A rare opportunity to build the home you've dreamt about at The Summit at Scherff, one of Western New York's most exclusive neighborhoods. This 1.29 acre vacant lot sits on a quiet cul-de-sac and offers the privacy and space for your new home. The lot is cleared, and ready for construction with no deed restrictions — your builder, your design, your timeline. All utilities are at the road ready for hookup including electric, natural gas, water, phone, public storm & sewer. Zoned single-family residential with no HOA and no restrictions. Located just minutes from the Villages of Orchard Park and East Aurora, with easy access to Route 219 for a quick 20-minute commute to downtown Buffalo. Orchard Park school district and close proximity to Erie County's Chestnut Ridge Park round out this unbeatable location.
